name: Mahalaxmi Temple, Kolhapur
summary: Kolhapur Mahalaxmi (Ambabai) is among Maharashtra’s foremost Devi temples.
mythology: Mahalaxmi Temple, Kolhapur at Kolhapur, Maharashtra is dedicated to Goddess Mahalaxmi (Ambabai), known especially for Ambabai — Maharashtra’s great Lakshmi shrine. Pilgrimage tradition places the shrine within India’s tirtha network — a seat where vows, gratitude, and family kuladevi / ishta devotion gather. Local sthala-purana and priestly teaching elaborate how Goddess Mahalaxmi (Ambabai) blesses those who arrive with sincere intent; festival days intensify these beliefs through special alankara and community worship where practised.
